answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the meadow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The falcon holds work receipts rather than names, so the ripple of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
